setup.sql: CREATE TABLE ev_f AS SELECT i AS id, timestamptz '2024-01-01 00:00+00' + (i::float8 / 2400000 * 730) * interval '1 day' AS ts, 1 + (i * 7919::bigint) % 1000 AS device, (i * 31::bigint) % 10000 AS val FROM generate_series(1, 2400000) i; CREATE INDEX ev_f_ts ON ev_f (ts); CREATE INDEX ev_f_device ON ev_f (device); ALTER TABLE ev_f SET (autovacuum_enabled = false); VACUUM ANALYZE ev_f;
